args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when
parsing deeply nested arrays, high severity). Version 2.9.4 contains
the fix; this is the minimal upgrade within the pinned 2.x line.

files.content:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Security: upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.head: bump-fastjson-2.9.4-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to address CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). 2.9.4 is the minimal fixed version within the pinned 2.x line (alternative fix: 3.1.0).

Also adds a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit 3a05f1e86f passed.

## Notes
- Bump only; no source changes required. This PR does not merge into main without code-owner approval.
